title: Rational open direct image preserves finite-constant-model constructibility
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$; all schemes are separated of finite type over $k$ and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in it. Let $\Lambda=E$, with the condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], or $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], pulled back to each scheme as in [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every $K\in\Dbc(U,\Lambda)$, where $\Dbc$ is the finite-constant-local-model bounded constructible category of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] and $Rj_*$ is the derived module direct image of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], one has $Rj_*K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$.

source.place: Integral coefficients paragraph and rational coefficients paragraph: derived-complete open direct image, integral generators, bounded continuity, and rational finite-subextension extension

proof.text: The schemes $U,X$ are separated and finite type over $k$. Since every ideal of the field $k$ is zero or the whole field, $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] makes $U,X$ Noetherian. They are qcqs by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine], and $j$ is qcqs by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1). These are exactly the Noetherian and qcqs hypotheses used below.

source.place: Standing setting; hypotheses for the integral criterion, generators and bounded continuity

proof.text: The hypothesis $K\in\Dbc(U,\Lambda)$ is already the finite-constant-local-model category defined in [sk-def-sfb-constructible], so [sk-lem-integral-models](4) applies directly to this $K$ (this is the needed input direction, rather than an implication from the weaker locally-finitely-presented predicate). It gives, for $\Lambda=E$, a finite construction by cones and shifts from $C=(a_!L_0)[1/\ell]$. For $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ the same clause gives such a construction from $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E',U}}a_!L_0$ for some finite $E'\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For each generator put $L=a_!L_0$. The same cited clause gives $L\in\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_{E'})$. The integral open-image theorem [det-thm-sf-pf-adic-open] therefore gives $M=Rj_*L\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_{E'})$. Its hypotheses hold for this same $j$ and for every finite $E'$. This is the integral paragraph of the source, already stated as a strictly smaller existing lemma. No conversion of the input $K$ to general ring-object constructibility is used.

source.place: Integral coefficients paragraph and rational paragraph: integral images of the generators of sk-lem-integral-models(4)

proof.text: Fix one such integral generator and write $E$ for its finite coefficient field. The localization [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell] identifies $E_T=\mathcal O_{E,T}[1/\ell]$ and makes this extension flat, for $T=U,X$. Thus $C=E_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}L$ is the sheafwise localization telescope $L\xrightarrow{\ell}L\to\cdots$; this follows by tensoring the localization cocone, since tensor is a left adjoint [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom, lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits]. Choose a bounded-below representative of the bounded $L$ and use the same representative at every stage. The common lower bound and qcqs $j$ permit [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qcqs-pushforward-continuity] at fixed $\mathcal O_E$ coefficients. Its canonical cohomology comparisons give $E_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}M\simeq Rj_*C$. For the coefficient action use [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]: restriction commutes with derived direct image and reflects isomorphisms. Its coefficient square is supplied by [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] and [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]. The telescope comparison respects scalar multiplication at every stage, so this is an $E_X$-linear isomorphism.

source.place: Rational paragraph, first sentence: invert ell by a uniformly bounded-below telescope and commute it with direct image

proof.text: The extension $E_T\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}N$ is bounded with finite constant local models whenever $N\in\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$, for $T=U,X$. Indeed flatness from [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell] and [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-preserves-homology] identify its degree-$q$ cohomology with $E_T\otimes H^q(N)$ and preserve the same vanishing interval. On any stratum and local-model cover of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], tensor the scalar finite presentation matrix with $E$. It is still a finite matrix with entries in the scalar ring $E$, so it is exactly a finite constant local model over $E_T$. Restrictions commute with coefficient extension by [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](1). In particular both $C$ and the extension of $M$ in step 3 are in their finite-constant-model $\Dbc$ categories. This proves the required image claim for every $E$-generator.

source.place: Rational paragraph: the images of rationalized integral generators lie in Dbc(X,E)

proof.text: For each finite $F/E$, choose an $E$-basis of $F$. By [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients](2), it gives $F_T\simeq E_T^{\oplus r}$, compatibly for $T=U,X$ by part (1). By [lem-sfb-subfield-flat], extension to $F$ is exact. After restriction to $E$, $F_T\otimes C$ is consequently $C^{\oplus r}$. The additive triangulated functor $Rj_*$ [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated] sends this to $(Rj_*C)^{\oplus r}$. Thus $F_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{E_X}Rj_*C\simeq Rj_*(F_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{E_U}C)$. This finite-sum map is $F$-linear: multiplication by any $b\in F$ is its basis matrix over $E$, and the $E$-linear derived module direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] sends that matrix to the same matrix. A change of basis or inclusion $F\hookrightarrow F'$ is also an $E$-linear matrix, so the comparisons commute with both. Exact scalar restriction and its derived direct-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] give the asserted comparisons in the coefficient categories. This is only the finite-sum calculation, not a use of a general direct-image constructibility theorem.

source.place: Rational paragraph, second sentence: the compatible finite-extension stages of extension to Qlbar

proof.text:
By [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,T}=\varinjlim_{F\supset E}F_T$. Use the small filtered poset of finite subextensions of the fixed algebraic closure. The tensor-colimit and tensor-transitivity assertions of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-flat-coefficient-calculus] identify the scalar extension of $C$ with $\varinjlim_{F\supset E}(F_U\otimes_{E_U}C)$ ; [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](3) further identifies it with $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,U}}L$. All finite stages have the same cohomological lower bound as $C$, by [lem-sfb-subfield-flat]. Choose bounded-below representatives using these exact tensor functors. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qcqs-pushforward-continuity] in the fixed $E_U$-module category and use the compatible comparisons of step 5. It gives
$$Rj_*(\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{E_U}C)\simeq\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{E_X}Rj_*C.$$
The comparison is linear for each finite $F$ and hence for their sheaf colimit. As in step 3, [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] transfers the fixed-coefficient calculation to the $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ direct image and reflects the isomorphism.

source.place: Rational paragraph, second and third sentences: bounded continuity over the finite subextensions

proof.text: In step 6, $Rj_*C$ has the finite constant local models proved in step 4. Extension from $E_X$ to $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is flat by [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat]. By [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-preserves-homology], it preserves cohomology and the same finite vanishing interval. On a stratum and local-model cover, its cohomology is presented by the same scalar finite matrix, now with entries mapped from $E$ to $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Restrictions commute with this extension by [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](1). This is a finite constant local model as defined by [sk-def-sfb-constructible], so the output lies in $\Dbc(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$. Together with tensor transitivity in step 6, this proves the image claim for every algebraic-closure generator of step 2.

source.place: Rational paragraph: images of the algebraic-closure integral generators have bounded constructible cohomology

proof.text: Return to the finite construction of $K$ in step 2. The functor $Rj_*$ commutes with shifts and distinguished triangles by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. The target finite-constant-model category contains zero, is invariant under isomorphism and shifts, and is closed under taking the third vertex of a triangle by [det-cor-coefficient-heart-ii-triangulated], applied on the Noetherian $X$. Induct on the finite list of shifts and cones constructing $K$. The generator case was proved in step 4 for $E$ and in step 7 for $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$; the shift and cone cases follow from the two cited statements. Therefore $Rj_*K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ for either coefficient choice.

source.place: Rational paragraph, final two sentences: finite generation and triangulated closure

proof_origin.place: Integral and rational paragraphs, expanded via existing integral open-image, integral generators, bounded continuity, explicit finite-sum coefficient comparisons and finite-constant-model matrices
